title: REPORT on the European Central Bank – annual report 2025
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘gender balanced’ and ‘of all genders’
part_context: Reiterates that the nominations to the ECB’s Executive Board should be gender-balanced, merit and ability-based, with shortlists submitted to Parliament, and that people of all genders should have equal opportunities to serve as governors of their respective national central banks;
